note: Both lower-deck cameras now stand inside the actual pressure-floor footprint, retain drag-look, and no longer expose the workshop beneath the creature room.
Rounded machine plinths and work surfaces replace repeated office desks, but the workshop still lacks dense wall tools, vehicle-scale machinery and convincing articulated complexity.
Each workshop station now exposes a two-link powered service arm, though its primitive geometry remains visually coarse.
Softened nest cushions and half-ring privacy coves create a recognizable creature-residence language and sit on a dedicated dark pressure floor.
Dark structural planes and warm/cyan practicals improve hierarchy, but surfaces remain flat, highlights are over-concentrated and the rooms lack cinematic layered light and material detail.
